description: Eight flip-flops, each toggling between 0V and 10V when triggered, pre-wired as a binary counter

params.text: Sets every flip-flop back to 0V by hand

inputs.text: A rising edge toggles that row's flip-flop between 0V and 10V; with nothing patched a row toggles when the stage before it falls, which divides the clock by two at each stage
A rising edge sets every flip-flop back to 0V

outputs.text: The state of that row's flip-flop, either 0V or 10V

notes: the module reads only the first channel of a polyphonic cable and its outputs are monophonic
